---
title: "Financial Reports"
---

ÇAHSPAR’s finances and use of resources are monitored in accordance with the principles of transparency, accountability and institutional responsibility. Financial reports provide accurate, reliable and accessible information about the association’s resource management and activities.

## Key Areas

- Budget planning and resource allocation
- Funding arrangements for projects and activities
- Expenditure and auditing
- Sustainable and responsible financial management

These reports help strengthen trust in the association and its relationship with society.
